_source: Hand tables, checked 2026-10-23 against Fortson 2010 (ch. 7) and Ringe 2017 (ch. 2); per-form verdicts in raw/books/extract/fortson/diff.jsonl, summarized in docs/morphology.md. Cells list alternatives, primary first. Book spellings without initial laryngeals (eǵ, yós, en, e-, apo) are kept as alternatives. Our laryngeal forms follow Wiktionary/LIV notation. Demonstrative ABL/INS: handbook contracted tósmōd, tóh₁ first (Fortson), Ringe's tósmead, tónoh₁ as alternatives (tier3-t001 review).

relative_yo._note: Inflects like so/tod (pronominal -sm- forms). Handbook-standard, UNVERIFIED, except h₁yosméy (dat./loc. sg.), attested in Byrd 2013 (Tier 1).

_refs.demonstrative_so/n/GEN.PL: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(ii) / p. 55; Fortson §7.9 gives only the ending *-sōm
_refs.demonstrative_so/f/DAT.PL: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(ii) / p. 55 (dat.-abl. téh₂mos; appended as alternative)
_refs.interrogative_kwi/mf/GEN.SG: Ringe 2017 p. 117 (§3.2.5) and p. 201 (§3.4.4(ii)): gen. sg. of *kʷi- ~ *kʷe- ('whose?'); Fortson §7.9 ending *-eso (OCS česo)
_refs.interrogative_kwi/n/GEN.SG: Ringe 2017 p. 117 (§3.2.5) and p. 201 (§3.4.4(ii)): gen. sg. of *kʷi- ~ *kʷe- ('whose?'); Fortson §7.9 ending *-eso (OCS česo)
_refs.interrogative_kwi/n/INS.SG: Fortson 2010 §19.10 (*kʷih₁ instr., > Alb. si, Lat. quī 'how'; printed unaccented, gender not stated)
_refs.personal/2/ACC.PL: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(iii) / p. 57 (Ringe uswé, after Katz); Fortson §7.6 stem *us-me- (primary)
_refs.numerals/2/fn/ACC.DU: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(i) / p. 53 (direct case = nom.-acc., neut. dwóy(h₁))
_refs.numerals/3/m/DAT.PL: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(i) / p. 53 (dat.-abl. trimós; appended as alternative)
_refs.numerals/4/m/DAT.PL: Ringe 2017 §2.3.6(i) / p. 54 (dat.-abl. kʷetwr̥mós; appended as alternative)
_refs.numerals/indeclinable/100: Ved. śatám, Gk ἑκατόν, Lat. centum, Goth. hund (Fortson §7.17)
_refs.numerals/indeclinable/1000: Ved. sahásram, Gk χίλιοι (Indo-Iranian and Greek only: weaker)
